Confirm the deployed page actually serves

wrangler_toml:
# Cloudflare Worker serving the laboratory page as static assets.
#
# No `main` script: this is an assets-only Worker, which is all the page needs —
# the F# is compiled to JavaScript ahead of time and runs in the browser.
#
# public/ is assembled by scripts/build-site.mjs and is gitignored. Deploying
# without running `npm run build` first would publish an empty directory, so the
# deploy workflow always builds.

name = "field-laboratory"
compatibility_date = "2026-08-09"

[assets]
directory = "./public"

# Serves /index.html for a bare "/" and returns a real 404 for anything missing,
# rather than silently rewriting unknown paths to the index — the page fetches
# ./data/*.json, and a 404 masked as an HTML page would surface as a confusing
# JSON parse error instead of a missing file.
not_found_handling = "none"
